page.layout: Two parallel columns of a Hebrew-Latin dictionary, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: entries from the top down to the bottom of the column. Right column: entries from the top down to "defuit." at the foot. Running head at the top of both pages, "מ ח" on the left and "מ ח" on the right. Page number 239 at the top right. No notes in the margins and no text below the columns.

page.notes: The scan is small and the Hebrew points (vowel signs) are faint, so the vowels in the Hebrew words are the least certain part of this transcription. Several Hebrew forms were read from their shape and could differ in the points: the second form in "מַחֲלָה, & מַחְלָה" and the root in "מְחַלְּמִים" are doubtful. The line "vel חַלַּל" after "Rad. חָלָה" is hard to read. The Pual line of the right column was read as "מְחַלְלִי". Latin abbreviations are kept as printed. Long s is written as plain s.
